ANNOTATION_read_this_first.provenance: Operator's own card-driven Real Go, 2026-08-20 21:57 UTC (17:57 EDT), recovered from the card's run history on 2026-08-21 and banked before the card overwrote it. NOT one of the scripted runs from that session.
ANNOTATION_read_this_first.headline: A 2.2735 m single vector segment REACHED TARGET at 0.11378 m, and it shows the same one-sided aim drift that killed the 3.0 m sub-leg -- 8 of 8 pulses negative, mean -10.87 deg. Leg length, not drift, is what separates the two outcomes.

\ud83d\udd11_the_one_sided_drift_reprodu.reading: Identical signature to the 2026-08-20 chain run, whose sub-leg 2 was -10.29 deg over 9 of 9 pulses. The error is not noise: it is consistent within a run and GROWS monotonically as range closes, because bearing-to-target rotates as cross-track accumulates. Three runs now show it.
\ud83d\udd11_the_one_sided_drift_reprodu.why_this_one_SUCCEEDED: The leg was 2.27 m, not 3.0 m. Same drift, shorter lever arm. This is direct support for `_correctable_leg_length_limit_m`: the outcome is set by how much cross-track the leg length lets an uncorrectable aim error accumulate.

ANNOTATION_read_this_first.the_suppression_guard_was_CORRECT_here: Two suppressions at 17.5 deg aim error projected landings of 0.1141 m and 0.0926 m, both inside the 0.15 m tolerance. It landed at 0.11378 m. The single-pulse lookahead was accurate at this geometry -- worth recording alongside the 2026-08-20 case where it projected 0.1273 m and the segment then fired two more pulses and landed 0.1673 m out. The guard is not wrong in general; it is a SINGLE-PULSE guard.
what_this_adds_to_the_leg_length_picture: The advisory bound is 0.580 m, so ALL of these exceed it and most still landed. Confirms the bound is pessimistic and must stay advisory.
ANNOTATION_read_this_first.still_unbanked: The card's landing table also shows an earlier 2-segment run at 2.72 m (landings 0.1319 and 0.0716, mean 0.1017, 2 of 2 target_reached). That run is NOT this file and has not been recovered. The card keeps ~3-5 full results, so it may already be gone.
ANNOTATION_read_this_first.gate: Operator-driven via the card; the run record shows all safety gates passed and blockers empty.

safety_gates.name: stop_primitive_available
safety_gates.detail: Coordinator must expose async_stop_manual_motion().

safety_gates.name: ble_transport_required
safety_gates.detail: Real closed-loop motion requires the BLE transport for responsive telemetry; cloud/Wi-Fi lag is unsafe for guarded path execution. BLE must also report itself usable -- being selected for routing does not mean a command can be delivered.

safety_gates.name: ble_link_live
safety_gates.detail: Real motion requires a conservative BLE preflight -- a live client, an open dispatch gate, an empty command queue, and a recent outbound attempt. 'Usable' only means BLE is eligible for routing; it stays True while the command queue is gated and commands (including the mandatory stop that bounds a pulse) accumulate undelivered. The send path separately waits for confirmed queue start and GATT-write completion. See docs/pymammotion-ble-slot-leak-bug.md.

safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires confirm_clear_area=true.

safety_gates.name: mower_reports_blades_off
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires blade state off and cutter RPM zero/unknown.

safety_gates.name: mower_ready
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires the mower to be ready/paused, not mowing or charging.

safety_gates.name: not_docked_or_charging

safety_gates.name: position_area_inside
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires AREA_INSIDE, TURN_AREA_INSIDE, or CHANNEL_AREA_OVERLAP and a nonzero known zone hash.

safety_gates.name: map_position_nonzero
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires nonzero map-local x/y coordinates.

safety_gates.name: segment_too_long
safety_gates.detail: Segment length is capped at 6.1 m by authorization, not by a measured reach limit; the longest segment ever executed is 4.0 m.

safety_gates.name: linear_budget_insufficient_for_segment
safety_gates.detail: 22 linear pulses reach about 6.60 m at a stall-tolerant 0.3 m/pulse, short of this segment.
